_: Pack combat (docs/backlog/combat.md, build step 1; Ed, 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-19), behind the tuning's combat.packs.on. A pack is one kind on one side after one target; it runs in phases: approach, the pack tell (every member glows, its call), a combo (the lunger, then the shooters, then the special: roles by position each step), a lull (its kind's retreat pattern), again. A new kind is an entry under kinds: its melee and ranged moves, its special (one of the specials below), its retreat (one of the retreats below), its rhythm and its pressure (how many of it may wind up or strike at her at once). Moves are on the level's power budget (combat.json levels): a move's damage is the level's dps times its cooldown, split over its shots.
_rhythms: By kind (Ed: 'a wolf pack combos fast and tight, a snail pack slow and wide'): tell, seconds every member glows before a combo; gap, seconds between a combo's steps (the lunge, the shots, the special); lull, seconds it falls back after a combo, plus perMember for each member past the first (Ed: 'a pair comes back in a second, a pack of eight takes a few'); timeout, the longest a combo runs.
_young: A young one's moves (Ed, 2026-10-15: 'young moves weak and slow'; the master curve: home's packs young, small and slow): its wind-ups times windup, its bolts' speed times speed and reach times range, its special's radius and time times special, and a pack of young lulls times lull longer.
_limits: Performance and readability (combat.md): at most combo members in a combo (the rest hold back), at most lanes melee strikes and lines shots at her at once, at most shots of a pack's in the air; hurt, the share of its health under which a member leaves the combo and keeps its distance; engage, metres past its reach at which a pack ends its approach; split, metres within which one of her party going for a member splits the pack.
_bolt: Every magic bolt (combat.md: 'one projectile sprite tinted'): the base its kinds' ranged moves are built on (range, shots and spread by kind).
_specials: Each special's numbers (the young times young.special): radius, metres it reaches; time, seconds it lasts; cooldown, seconds before the pack may use it again. call: all may strike within time; feint: the fake tell's seconds (lead); confusion: her aim turns up to drift degrees; cloud: hides the tells inside it; wall: a line length long of patches that slow her to slow; rally: heals heal hits' worth; cover: digs in by a hurt packmate (else the one she's inviting) and takes its hits, armour its damage times; scatter: hidden time, then round her at ring times its reach; stampede: rolls at her curled up, as the kind's charge.
_retreats: Each retreat pattern (the lull's movement, round her): out, metres from her it falls back to; hide, whether it's out of sight (untouchable, not drawn) for the middle of the lull and back from another side; still, whether it stands where it is.
_kinds: Home's ten (combat.md's table; Echo adds Phase 1's the same way). melee: an attack in combat.json by level [baby, young, adult] (null: none; absent: the kind's own), knockback metres added; ranged: a bolt's reach, shots by level, spread degrees, size times, tint (null: none); special and retreat by name; rhythm; pressure; call and tell for the view and the sounds (what the pack does as its tell, and each move's tell).
_hers: Her own pack (Ed, 2026-10-15: 'the same combos, but no retreats or scatters'): between combos it holds where it is for hold seconds instead of a lull; a special the wild side uses on her it uses on the wild (a confusion slows them, mind control becomes a stun for stun seconds).
